basic_details.job_title: CSIR CEERI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 10 Project Associate, Project Associate and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Central Electronics Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-CEERI) has announced 10 vacancies for Project Staff Positions on a purely temporary engagement for various ongoing projects. The engagement is initially for six months or co-terminus with the present project, with pay and qualification requirements varying by post as specified in the official notification. Eligible candidates can apply through the online portal available on the CSIR-CEERI website from 16.10.2026 to 02.11.2026, and must take a printout of the application form after successful submission. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For PAT-II: M.Tech/ M.E in Electronics and Communication Engineering/ Microwave; OR B.Tech/ B.E in Electronics and Communication Engineering/ Microwave and 2 years experience in R&D; OR M.Sc in Physics/ Electronics/ Optoelectronics/ Microwave and 2 years experience in R&D. Senior PAT: M.Tech/ M.E in Electronics and Communication Engineering/ Microwave; OR B.Tech/ B.E in Electronics and Communication Engineering/ Microwave and 2 years experience in R&D; OR M.Sc in Physics/ Electronics/ Optoelectronics/ Microwave and 3 years experience in R&D. For Project Assistant-II: B.Sc/ 3 years diploma in engineering & technology (ECE/ EE/ Physics/ Electronics/ Material Science) or equivalent. Desirable: Working knowledge of embedded systems, knowledge of PCB design, programming skills in Arduino, knowledge of circuit design. For PAT-I: B.E/ B.Tech/ M.Sc (Electronics/ ECE/ EEE/ Electronics & Instrumentation/ Electrical Engineering/ Electronics & Telecommunication/ Microwave/ Mechatronics/ MEMS/ Physics) or equivalent. Desirable: Working knowledge of embedded systems, knowledge of PCB design, Microcontroller programming, programming skills in Arduino knowledge of circuit design, PCB design. For JRF: Graduate degree/B.E./B.Tech./Post Graduate degree/ M.E./M.Tech. in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Instrumentation, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline. Additionally, candidates must have been selected through any one of the following: (a) National Eligibility Tests such as CSIR-UGC NET (including Lectureship/Assistant Professorship) or GATE; OR (b) National-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies/Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IITs, IISc, IISERs, NISER, etc. For Project Associate – I: B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Instrumentation, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline. For Project Associate – II: B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Instrumentation, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline with a minimum of 2 years’ experience in Research & Development in industrial/academic institutions or science & technology organizations, including scientific activities and services. OR Master’s / Integrated Master’s Degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline. Doctoral Degree in Science or Master’s Degree in engineering or technology from recognized university or equivalent. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR CEERI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Read the instruction given on the CSIR-CEERI Website on Project Staff Recruitment Page. Apply through online portal available on CSIR-CEERI website. Upload scanned copies of required academic certificates (10th Standard, 12th Standard, Diploma Degree, Graduation Degree, Post-Graduation), Date of Birth Proof, category certificate, NET/GATE/equivalent exam qualification certificate, experience certificate, and other certificates. Submit the online application before the last date. Take a print out of the Application Form after successfully submission of the form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Received applications will be screened by duly constituted Standing Screening Committee. Shortlisted candidates will be informed through 'E-mail/Institute website' along with the date and time for interview. Candidates will have to appear for the interviews through "Microsoft Teams" (MS Teams) as a Guest, for which the link will be sent to your registered Email. The selected candidates are expected to join immediately upon selection and bring with them all ORIGINAL TESTIMONIALS including application form, mark sheets & certificates and also a passport size photograph at the time of joining, failing which their engagement can be withdrawn.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSIR CEERI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CSIR CEERI Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification issued by the Central Electronics Engineering Research Institute to engage 10 Project Staff positions purely temporary engagements for various ongoing projects in the Institute.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies have been announced across various posts including Senior PAT, PAT-II, Project Assistant-II, PAT-I, JRF, Project Associate-I, Project Associate-II, Project Scientist-I, and Project Scientist-II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date & time for applying applications is 02.11.2026 till 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for Project Scientist positions?
faq.answer: Doctoral Degree in Science or Master’s Degree in engineering or technology from recognized university or equivalent, with 3 years experience in R&D for Project Scientist-II.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The upper age limit varies by post, being 35 years for PAT-II, Project Assistant-II, PAT-I, and Project Associates/JRF (30 years for JRF), 40 years for Senior PAT, and 55 years for Project Scientists, with age relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST/PwD/Women and 3 years for OBC.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee specified in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for online interview through "Microsoft Teams" (MS Teams) based on screening by a Standing Screening Committee.

faq.question: Q8. Are these permanent positions in CSIR-CEERI?
faq.answer: No, these are not CSIR-CEERI/CSIR posts and will be made on behalf of the Sponsor of the Projects, conferring no right to claim on any post in CSIR-CEERI/CSIR.
